entries.prompt:
Generate VERSION A: isolate the EXISTING rigid SILVER-GREY ENFORCER BIOMASK from this official NECA Ultimate Bad Blood vs Enforcer2-pack2018 photograph. The source mask is the worn silver shell around x289..481,y91..365 in the867x1299 image. Preserve the actual photographed three-quarter projection facing towards the viewer-left, slightly bowed/tilted as shown, and projected silhouette INCLUDING its tall very thin central curved blade. This is the exact NECA2018 edition, not the existing project V62 reconstruction and not a new mask design.
Preserve the real rounded grey/silver crown, shallow swept raised brow rim whose left and right tips point up, the distinctive long narrow central fin rising well above the crown and curving gently to its point, the narrow dark eye lenses under the low brow, the short rounded rectangular central nose block, the sculpted angular cheek sections, and the source-observed metallic circular lateral fitting at the viewer-right temple/cheek with its black circular center and short rigid mechanical housing. That small side fitting belongs with the mask's visible hard contour; the much larger gun BELOW the mask on the shoulder belongs to the body and must be excluded. Preserve only the visible hard connections; do not invent a reverse side or new support arm.
Retain the ACTUAL simple BLUE block-like forehead mark under the tall fin, the source's broad contour grooves and restrained grey/silver paint. The violet highlights in the scene are LIGHT, not purple painted panels: render neutral light and keep neutral silver/grey albedo. No invented readable runes, extra glyphs, surface inscriptions, vents, screws, decorative spikes or new damage to compensate for source resolution. The small mark should remain the simple photographed coarse blue stroke, not new text. The thin fin must stay thin and intact, not become a broad horn or sword blade. No camera rotation to frontal and no redesign.
Remove all organic wearer anatomy, eyes behind lenses, dreadlocks, straps, throat, body/shoulder armor, shoulder cannon, skulls, arms, blades, scenery, text and base. One complete visible rigid shell with only its source-attested exterior fittings, neutral soft studio lighting and existing restrained worn collectible metal. Genuine transparent alpha, centered, about76–80%of larger canvas axis including the full tall fin,8–12%clear margins all sides. No clipping, no backdrop/floor/shadow plane/checkerboard/UI/logos/multiple views. One native finished transparent PNG. Named licensed NECA2018 edition study of Enforcer family, new canonical geometry=false; not certification of original comic-panel geometry.

entries.prompt:
Create VERSION B of this EXACT existing NECA Ultimate Enforcer2018 rigid grey/silver biomask. FIRST reference is version A: preserve its entire rigid sculpture, actual three-quarter camera towards viewer-left, shallow crown, swept raised brow rim with two upturned edge tips, full very thin curved tall central blade, dark lenses, short rounded rectangular nose and cheeks, simple real blue forehead mark and actual circular hard lateral fitting with dark center. SECOND reference is the official2018 photo; it supports the neutral grey/silver paint and source identity, not a reason to rotate the view or import the shoulder cannon/dreadlocks. Keep exactly the same projected proportions, including fin length/thickness and body relation. No new horns/spines, no new tiny glyphs, fasteners, engravings, vents, holes or damage. The existing coarse blue stroke is a painted mark, not a newly readable word; do not add decorations around it. This is an exact named licensed NECA2018 edition study of Enforcer family, newCanonicalGeometry=false, not a certified original comic panel or project V62 sculpt.
Change ONLY material and light to cohesive PHG game-asset quality: neutral white upper-left key plus soft neutral fill, physically readable restrained brushed/cast grey-silver metal, controlled roughness with subtle micrograin and existing dark lenses/recesses, no white chrome shine, coloured violet light, excessive grain, new dirt or damage. Preserve the source albedo and same camera/geometry. No flesh, human/alien eyes, teeth, organic mouth, dreads, straps, throat, body, shoulder cannon, armor, weapon, background, text or logos.
Improve ONLY canvas breathing room while keeping the same object shape: include the whole thin fin intact with at least10%empty transparent space ABOVE its tip and BELOW the chin, and at least10%left/right clear margin. The longest visible object dimension should be about78-80%of canvas, not94%as A. This is an ImageGen canvas composition, never stretch or shorten the fin to fit. One complete object centered on genuine transparent alpha, no clipping, opaque background, floor/shadow plane/checkerboard/UI/caption/multiple views/contact sheet. One native finished transparent PNG.
